read: Phones bright, crowd buzzing, hungry for a massive anthem; I feel a wave of anticipation building.

tracks.title: Titanium
tracks.why: Iconic vocal anthem, instantly lifts energy, phones light up.
tracks.transition: High‑pass filter out, drop beat into Animals' synth.

tracks.title: Animals
tracks.why: Recognizable drop, crowd erupts, keeps momentum.
tracks.transition: Cut low end, loop vocal into Reload intro.

tracks.artist: Sebastian Ingrosso, Tommy Trash feat. John Martin
tracks.title: Reload
tracks.why: Melodic big‑room, sing‑along hook, maintains peak.
tracks.transition: Echo fade, sudden bass hit into Turn Down for What.

tracks.title: Turn Down for What
tracks.why: Aggressive chant, ignites frenzy, instant crowd roar.
tracks.transition: Rapid filter sweep, crossfade into Mammoth's synth.

tracks.title: Mammoth
tracks.why: Heavy bass, massive impact, crowd goes wild.
tracks.transition: Bass drop resolves, open melodic break to Wake Me Up.

tracks.title: Wake Me Up
tracks.why: Uplifting anthem, everyone sings, perfect fireworks climax.
